title: A sprint review re-runs every done item's checks once on the sprint's tip
goal: /kb-sprint review (with backlog.py support) re-runs the checks of every done item of the sprint once on the tip before done, and names each that now fails, so an item whose check fails on main does not close with the sprint; a test plants a done item whose check fails at the tip. Answers the SP-w3xmbdra retrospective: BG-k5dql2np, ST-ykvho3zp, ST-5q5b5qtz and ST-n3swrm57 closed with a perfcheck ids check that printed '10 missing' and exits 1 on main.

run:
import sys, tempfile, pathlib
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import bl_land
d = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
need = [sys.executable, '-c', 'import os, sys; sys.exit(0 if os.path.exists("b.txt") else 1)']
fail = [sys.executable, '-c', 'import sys; sys.exit(1)']
class BL:
    root = d
    items = {'T1': {'status': 'done', 'checks': [{'run': need}]}, 'T2': {'status': 'todo', 'checks': [{'run': fail}]}, 'R1': {'status': 'done', 'review': True, 'checks': [{'run': fail}]}}
    def sprint_items(self, sid):
        return list(self.items)
bl = BL()
stale = bl_land.rerun_done_checks(bl, 'S')
assert [i for i, c, code in stale] == ['T1'], stale
assert stale[0][2] == 1, stale
(d / 'b.txt').write_text('b')
assert bl_land.rerun_done_checks(bl, 'S') == []
print('rerun names the failing done item only; clean once fixed')
